newsitem.title: UK: KEXIM plans 500 mln mark five-year FRN this week.
newsitem.headline: KEXIM plans 500 mln mark five-year FRN this week.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Korea (KEXIM) will launch a 500 million mark five-year FRN this week, a syndicate manager at lead manager DG Bank said on Monday.
"We have the mandate to launch a 500 million mark five-year Eurobond for KEXIM," the syndicate manager told Reuters.
He said the issue was aimed at European investors and could be launched as early as Tuesday.
"Roadshows were unnecessary as KEXIM is a well-known name among German investors," he added.
Dealers said price talk was in the region of LIBOR plus 18 to 18.5 basis points all-in.
Earlier this month, KEXIM launched a $500 million five-year global bond to yield 45 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
State-owned KEXIM is rated A1 by Moody's Investors Service and AA- by Standard & Poor's Corp.
